final: WITH per_track AS (SELECT m.Name AS MediaType, 1.0 * t.Bytes / t.Milliseconds AS BytesPerMs FROM Track t JOIN MediaType m ON m.MediaTypeId = t.MediaTypeId WHERE t.Bytes >= 10323804 AND t.Milliseconds > 0), per_type AS (SELECT MediaType, AVG(BytesPerMs) AS AvgBytesPerMs FROM per_track GROUP BY MediaType), overall AS (SELECT AVG(AvgBytesPerMs) AS OverallAvg FROM per_type) SELECT p.MediaType, p.AvgBytesPerMs, p.AvgBytesPerMs - o.OverallAvg AS AboveOverallBy FROM per_type p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE p.AvgBytesPerMs > o.OverallAvg ORDER BY p.AvgBytesPerMs DESC
